notes: Biogen records ZURZUVAE sales as its own product revenue (Sage, then Supernus, receives 50% of U.S. net collaboration results through collaboration profit sharing, per the Biogen releases). Scope is the U.S. column (USD millions, one decimal). Total (U.S.+Rest of World) differs only from 2026Q1: 2026Q1 55.4, 2026Q2 70.8. Biogen's releases fold ZURZUVAE into 'Total Other Product Revenue (ADUHELM, FUMADERM and ZURZUVAE)' for 2023Q4 and 2024Q1 and print a rounded prose figure only (2023Q4 'approximately $2 million', 2024Q1 'approximately $12 million'); the first separate table row is the 2024Q2 release. 2023Q4 (1.6) and 2024Q1 (12.4) are therefore the year-earlier columns of the 2024Q4 and 2025Q1 releases (direct_prior_year_column). Cross-checks: 2024 12.4+14.9+22.0+22.9=72.2 and 2025 27.7+46.4+55.3+65.7=195.1 equal the full-year U.S. figures printed in the Q4 releases; the FY2024 10-K prints 1.6 for full-year 2023 (all in Q4). Sage's own filings record Zurzuvae as collaboration revenue and were not used.
search_log: Listed Biogen (CIK 0000875045) filings from data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older files), keeping every 8-K and 8-K/A with item 2.02: 25 filings 2022-02 to 2026-07; the 2022-07-20 8-K/A (0000875045-22-000023) is a re-filing of the same release and the original 8-K was used.

Downloaded the EX-99.1 earnings release of each quarter's 8-K from 2021Q4 to 2026Q2 (exhibit991-q<N><YYYY>pressrele.htm) and parsed every table row; selected the first row whose label equals the product (the three-month table; the year-to-date table follows it).
Downloaded all Biogen 10-K and 10-Q filings 2023-02 to 2026-07 and searched the text for the brand names and the revenue-note product tables.

Biogen prints no ZURZUVAE row before the 2024Q2 release; the 2023Q4 and 2024Q1 releases and the matching 10-K/10-Q carry only 'Other (FUMADERM, ADUHELM and ZURZUVAE)'. The exact quarterly values come from the year-earlier columns of the 2025Q4 and 2025Q1 releases (rows 22.9 / nil / 22.9 / 1.6 / nil / 1.6 and 27.7 / nil / 27.7 / 12.4 / nil / 12.4).
Checked the FY2024 10-K revenue note: ZURZUVAE 72.2 (2024) and 1.6 (2023), matching the releases.
Sage (CIK 0001597553) and Supernus were not needed: the line exists at Biogen for the whole span. Existing gold has sage_zulresso (a different product, brexanolone).
